title:
Every event.
In context.
text: Events arrive separately. A useful history puts them back in order. Follow the lot through its process events, wafer states and durations.
beats: Separate records enter the view.
Timestamps bring the sequence together.
Follow the lot without losing its context.
caption: Lot history analysis.

title:
Know what
comes next.
text: A schedule is useful when you can see the work around it. Bring ANKO dates into view across the Altus equipment.
beats: Equipment schedules begin as separate lanes.
The lanes settle into a shared view.
Attention moves to the work ahead.
caption: ANKO schedule retrieval.

title:
Make usage
visible.
text: Equipment logs hold a history of use. Bring wafer counts into view as a clearer basis for maintenance planning.
beats: Wafer activity starts as individual events.
Activity gathers around each chamber.
Usage becomes something you can review.
caption: Chamber usage and wafer counts.

title:
Numbers have
a shape.
text: A column of measurements tells part of the story. TopoTracer places them across the wafer, so spatial variation becomes visible.
caption: Contour and topography plots.
beats: Discrete points preserve individual measurements.
Contours reveal the shape between the points.
The wafer becomes a field you can read.

title:
Find the change.
Keep the meaning.
text: When steps move, a line-by-line comparison loses the thread. Papyrus Reader follows equivalent steps and brings the differences forward.
caption: Logical recipe and text comparison.
beats: The same recipe steps occupy different positions.
Equivalent steps find their counterparts.
The unchanged settles back. Differences remain.

title:
Less searching.
More seeing.
text: Find the charts you need across workcentres and parameter groups. Keep the path to the right information in view.
beats: A workcentre contains many possible paths.
One parameter group comes into focus.
The selected path resolves into a chart.
caption: SPC chart finder.

title:
From data
to a report.
text: Scattered metrology inputs become a consistent report. Gather the files, apply the predefined calculations and follow the result.
beats: Separate measurement inputs enter the workspace.
A common calculation structure brings them together.
The inputs resolve into a consistent report.
caption: Metrology report compiler.

title:
A signal.
A direction.
text: Temperature drift raises questions. GaN Temp Diagnoser connects observed behavior with likely causes and the checks worth making next.
caption: Temperature drift diagnosis.
beats: Observed temperature behavior opens several questions.
The observations narrow the possible directions.
Recommended checks provide a place to start.

title:
An arrangement
with reason.
text: Weight and temperature inputs guide baseplate arrangement. Put the basis for the decision alongside the spatial result.
beats: Baseplate inputs remain separate from their positions.
The arrangement takes shape around the process.
Review the placement and the inputs behind it.
caption: Baseplate arrangement guidance.

title:
Every zone.
A shared view.
text: Map LayTec zones against the same geometry. See the inner and outer regions in relation to the whole.
beats: Individual regions begin with a common origin.
Boundaries extend into the measurement geometry.
Inner and outer zones share one spatial view.
caption: LayTec zone mapping.

title:
Make changes
unmistakable.
text: Compare Devices.XML configurations, settings and constants. Bring differences forward while keeping their context intact.
beats: Reference and target properties enter side by side.
Matching properties line up for comparison.
Changed values remain visible in their context.
caption: Devices.XML comparison.

title:
Keep the process
in perspective.
text: Review configured GaN SPC charts and parameter states together. Move from a signal to the surrounding process context.
beats: Equipment and parameter context frame the review.
The configured charts come into view.
Follow a signal without losing the broader picture.
caption: GaN SPC release review.

title:
A familiar process.
A clearer view.
text: Keep established SPC workflows within reach. Bring legacy parameter states and charts into one review environment.
beats: The parameter index provides a familiar entry point.
One parameter opens into its chart.
State and chart remain in the same review.
caption: Legacy SPC release review.

title:
Plan with the
whole picture.
text: Bring ANKO status and due dates together. See what needs attention before deciding what comes next.
beats: Equipment status and due dates begin apart.
The two views align around the same equipment.
Planning starts with the relevant context in view.
caption: ANKO status and due dates.

title:
A consistent
report.
text: Assemble LayTec information into an engineering report. A repeated reporting task becomes a repeatable process.
beats: LayTec records enter as separate source material.
Their contents gather into a common structure.
A report takes the place of repeated assembly.
caption: LayTec report compilation.

title:
The picture
between signals.
text: Equipment parameters make more sense together. Metria SPC brings related charts into one view, with interactive analysis to follow the detail.
caption: Interactive multi-parameter equipment SPC.
beats: Individual parameter traces begin on separate axes.
A shared time window brings the signals together.
Move through the same interval across every trace.
